correctness.rationale: Substituting Z=0 rotating equilibria yields squared active amplitudes (βj-8Cr)/kr and phase closure sum rj exp(iθj)=0; division by common scale leaves the ordered five link polygon sqrt(t+j), j=0..4. Positivity of exactly five amplitudes equals 0<t<1. Among subsets containing the longest side sqrt(t+4), only triple {e,a,b} and pair {e,c} switch short/long; differentiating their signed square-root sums proves strict monotonicity and unique roots. Independent high precision root computation found t0=0.02075286255..., t1=0.38628071405..., and direct independent subset enumeration at t=.001,.1,.8 recovered (a0,a1,a2)=(1,2,1),(1,2,0),(1,3,0). Farber–Schütz Theorem1 then yields Betti (2,4,2),(1,4,1),(1,6,1); its disconnected result gives two tori in first regime, then genus2/3 by orientability and connectedness. At the wall a collinear configuration violates regular-value smoothness; no topology of singular fiber is asserted. Verified physical-line conversion Ci=0.005+(3-t_j)Δβ/14 and branch Ci>0 for chosen physical parameters. The bounded checks verify signs and examples; derivative/order and published polygon homology establish continuum classification.
residual_risks: Depends on general polygon-space Betti theorem with correct genericity hypotheses; the claim deliberately excludes threshold singular fibers and dynamical stability.

value.rationale: Two distinct internal topology transitions occur while the active-oscillator number stays five, separating a physical active-count threshold from the intrinsic topology of the phase-closure manifold. Sharp algebraic balance equations and genus assignments give a natural, complete parameter-specific classification relevant to understanding the multiplicity/connectivity of relative equilibria. residual_risks: This is a model-specific but meaningful application of known general topology; an unindexed specialized computation could supersede it.

final_claim: In the stipulated eight-site Stuart–Landau zero-mean five-active branch, the rotating phase configurations modulo common S1 rotation but not reflection identify with planar five-link polygons of lengths sqrt(t),sqrt(t+1),...,sqrt(t+4), 0<t<1. Two unique internal radicand-balance thresholds t0~0.02075286 and t1~0.38628071 change the smooth generic moduli from two disjoint tori to genus2 to genus3 without changing the active site count.
limitations: Only five active oscillators j=4..8 under stated parameter ratios, 0<t<1; no topology at singular walls or other active branches.
Relative-equilibrium manifold topology only, not transverse stability, physical attractors or basins.
